$Comment: Earned by finishing the Howling Sands questline's last quest. Worth more than its Wilds
counterpart because it sits at the end of a much longer road.
The payout waits in the achievements menu to be collected.
Criteria is an ORDERED list and the order is permanent: progress is filed per criterion by its
POSITION, so adding one to the end is safe while inserting, removing or reordering moves every
player's progress onto a different line.
